SMTO-SKL-0192 — SMTO's built-in management tools aren't available right now

GUID: 741d43f3-1e90-5902-adf5-10ff6dd5a447
Slug: tool-management-service-unavailable
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: management

What happened

  • SMTO tried to use one of its own management tools, such as managing tasks, notifications or system health, but that part of SMTO wasn't connected to this Run. Nothing was done.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Do the action directly in the app instead, for example from Settings or System Health in the More options menu, or the Notifications bell at the top. Those pages use the same SMTO features, so you can finish the job without the agent's tool.
  2. If you want the agent to do it, type /restart in the message box, wait until SMTO is ready again, then ask once more. This tool is only connected once SMTO has fully started, so a Run started too early can miss it.
  3. If you started SMTO in a special way (for example a test or command-line setup), start it the normal way with ./startup.sh or the installed app. Some ways of starting SMTO leave out its management features.

What success looks like

  • The agent completes the management action and reports its result, or you see the change on the matching page.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who installed SMTO, saying which action you asked for.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A product management tool (task, conversation, system, cache, monitor, notification or Gateway management) ran without a bound product management service, so it was not executed.

What this means

  • The controller management service required by this tool is unavailable. The classification describes only the condition observed by the producer.

Why this can happen

  • The required controller management service is not bound.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the retained operation, condition and effect evidence before choosing a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • ProductTool.execute in skills/_shared/product.py found no product_management_service in the run context (it is set by route_groups/services.py during full Server startup and copied into native run context by native/state.py). Confirm the Server finished starting with the agent UI services, restart it if the run began before initialization, and avoid embedded or test runtimes that omit the service; the result records executed=false.
  • Restore the controller service and verify its readiness before invoking this management operation again.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the reported condition first; existing effect evidence and replay checks still decide whether a new attempt is permitted.

How to verify the fix

  • The reported prerequisite is satisfied and a new authorized operation returns its actual result.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a write whose external effect is still unknown.

Technical notes

  • Diagnostic presentation does not start recovery or alter authorization.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
